questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “The term atom, the ancient Greek “atomos” is” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula “Atom atamasi, qadimgi yunoncha “atomos” atamasi”ni shu kabi fikrlardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: History of the development of knowledge about structure
Electrically neutral particle consisting of a nucleus and electrons
Positively charged particle of the nucleus of an atom
choicesUz: Yadro va elektronlardan tashkil topgan elektr neytral zarracha
explanationEn: The term atom, the ancient Greek “atomos”, means “indivisible.”
explanationUz: Qadimgi yunoncha "atomos" atamasi "bo'linmas" degan ma'noni anglatadi.
